title: USA₮ launches with Anchorage Digital Bank as issuer
description: Tether announced the official launch of USA₮, a U.S.-dollar stablecoin issued by Anchorage Digital Bank, N.A. and described as fully backed by liquid reserves.
notes: Primary launch announcement and product material establish identity, issuer, launch and 1:1 USD redemption claim.

title: Anchorpoint begins HKDAP Beta Access rollout
description: Anchorpoint began limited institutional Beta Access for HKDAP, with issuance and redemption available to eligible participants under the issuer's current onboarding and compliance requirements.
notes: This records the operational Beta Access start without inferring broader full-launch retail availability.
